name: Burpee Pull-Up
instructions: Stand directly under a pull-up bar with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Jump your feet back to the squat position.
Explosively jump up and grab the pull-up bar with both hands.
Immediately perform one pull-up, bringing your chin above the bar.
Drop down from the bar and land softly, then begin the next repetition.
